fluff.overview:
Every Concordat world maintains infantry formations as the first line of planetary defense, drawn from a population whose fierce independence and hatred of foreign aggression run deep. Mechanized wheeled platoons offer a balance of speed and economy, their wheeled transports being cheaper to maintain than hover or tracked alternatives. For a military that must stretch limited resources across a significant number of garrison worlds, this cost efficiency matters as much as tactical performance.

Support elements carry man-portable short-range missile launchers firing the same warheads used by BattleMechs and combat vehicles, giving the platoon a potent anti-armor punch at close range.
